findings.title: check-docs seeding contradicts the doc's 'seeds live inside the project' claim; undocumented
findings.description: ARCHITECTURE.md states 3x, unqualified, that seeded copies live 'inside the project, under .gbg/scratch/<round>/' to keep a Workflow agent's Read prompt-free. But check-docs's own seed_docs_corpus! copies the corpus to mktempdir() (system temp, outside the repo per the code's own comment), and repoint_lanes points lane agents there. This whole feature is also absent from §6.4/§6.6.
findings.resolution_hint: Document the check-docs seeding mechanism as an explicit exception with its own-outside-project justification, or move the destination under .gbg/scratch/<round>/ to match the stated invariant.

locations: src/CLI/Design.jl (gbg attack/calibrate, absent from §3's CLI/ tree)
findings.description: D11 says 'Eighteen schemas' and lists 18; §3 describing the same directory says 'the sixteen of D11' — an internal 18-vs-16 contradiction. Actual schema/ holds 22 files; the 4 missing back gbg attack/gbg calibrate (src/CLI/Design.jl), which the tool's own module docstring names but ARCHITECTURE.md's §3 repo tree never lists, along with catalog/attack/.
findings.resolution_hint: Update D11 to name all 22 schemas (or scope the 18 explicitly) and fix §3's count to match; add Design.jl and catalog/attack/ to §3's trees.
